faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the NIFTEM Young Professional Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Institute of Food Technology Entrepreneurship and Management, Kundli (NIFTEM) for filling research positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Young Professional post under advertisement number IDS-20030/1/2026 in the Nano Biosensor Laboratory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the completed application form via email is 20 October 2026 by 6:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for Young Professional?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a B.Tech in Biotechnology, M.Sc or M.Tech in Life Science, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Nanoscience, Biomedical, Molecular Biology, or be a Ph.D. Candidate (N-PDF).

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Young Professional post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 37000/- plus 10% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for NIFTEM recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly through email. Candidates must send the soft copy of their application to [email protected] and [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Young Professional position is 35 years, with permissible age relaxation for reserved category candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is specified in the official notification for submitting the application form for the Young Professional position.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for NIFTEM Young Professional?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises initial application screening followed by a Hybrid Mode Interview for shortlisted eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and website details?
faq.answer: You can check the official NIFTEM website at www.niftem.ac.in or refer to the important links section provided in this notification article.
